subject: reasoning
question: Pratik starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km, then turns right and drives 17 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Pratik starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards the north.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km, then turns right and drives 17 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P.
